# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-16 from the 2026-11-16 Hub dump.

- 3,238,961 models tracked, 932,928 declare a base model, 966,268 parent links, 92,516 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
